'''''Thoughts Among the Ruins''''' is a book from "over a thousand years" before the end of the [[Third Age]]. At the time of [[Rand]]'s dream meeting with [[Moridin]], [[Min]] had marked a place in it with [[Herid Fel's note]]. Min's copy was from [[Herid Fel]]'s collection.{{ref/book|12|15}}
